==Problem==

In the multiplication problem below <imath>A</imath>, <imath>B</imath>, <imath>C</imath>, <imath>D</imath> are different digits. What is <imath>A+B</imath>? 

<cmath> \begin{array}{cccc}& A & B & A\\ \times & & C & D\\ \hline C & D & C & D\\ \end{array} </cmath>

<imath> \textbf{(A)}\ 1\qquad\textbf{(B)}\ 2\qquad\textbf{(C)}\ 3\qquad\textbf{(D)}\ 4\qquad\textbf{(E)}\ 9 </imath>

==Solution 1==

<imath>CDCD = CD \odot 101</imath>, so <imath>ABA = 101</imath>. Therefore, <imath>A = 1</imath> and <imath>B = 0</imath>, so <imath>A+B=1+0=\boxed{\textbf{(A)}\ 1}</imath>.
